**Problem report**

In the library open Settings, About and press "Copy problem report", then paste it below. It shows you everything before
copying and leaves out keys, cookies, passwords, folder paths and game names.

If the library does not open at all, paste the last lines of `docker logs <container>` instead, and check them for anything
private first. If you see a page saying the database did not open, tell us what it says.
